remaining_concerns: No admissible evidence was provided showing that the current release documentation actually reflects current evaluation results for this release.
No admissible evidence was provided showing the exact current-release disclosure of the health-plan benefits support weakness.
No admissible evidence was provided of an approved mitigation or reviewed risk acceptance for the named segment weakness.
The actor's position remains conditional on documentation existing; that caveat is itself an unresolved compliance predicate under the policy.
Aggregate readiness and absence of severity-one rehearsal incidents remain insufficient on their own to satisfy the model-card disclosure requirement for a known weak segment.
final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor supplied no new admissible evidence and instead narrowed the claim to a caveated reading of the same record. That reinterpretation is analytically cleaner, but it does not resolve the core policy predicate. The policy allows certification only if current release documentation reflects current evaluation results and the material segment weakness is disclosed or covered by approved mitigation. On the available evidence, that condition remains unproven. This is therefore not clean compliance, and it is not compliant_with_caveats, because the caveat is not merely a disclosure about an otherwise satisfied record; it is the missing compliance requirement itself.
